conventions.upper: token-weighted max prompt LCP against strictly earlier sends in same instance, all history retained; no block rounding or causality-of-prefill penalty
conventions.throughput: lambda/60 * mean(sum prompt tokens per root) * (1-hit); exact stationary mean, no initialization bias
conventions.working_set: distinct prompt-prefix KV of latest sent request of every live chain, no cross-instance sharing; drops at final completion; excludes outputs and is a lower bound
conventions.provisioning: 2.5*max(saturated,scheduled) KV P90 <= GPU < CPU <= 0.8*working-set P50; 1.5 <= CPU/GPU <=2; CPU/GPU targets 1.5,1.75,2; host reserve 15% MemAvailable
conventions.capacity_lines: 22k and 34k token/s are user-supplied exclusive compute assumptions, not measured in this run
conventions.limits: KV-only CPU footprint; GPU non-KV reserve assumed 30 GiB; vLLM staging/process overhead and CPU bandwidth require pilot validation
